scope: Standing public-facing exterior of Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, with the New Safe Confinement arch and the adjoining long industrial hall and main visible building volumes.

originalReview.notes: The native ground photograph establishes the visible silver arch silhouette, broad cladding, exterior end wall and neighboring pale industrial volume. The foreground sculpture and temporary objects are unrelated to the model.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla original was screened first and depicts a schematic. The standing exterior shape uses Hnapel’s verified native public-domain CC0 upload, the plant operator’s published exterior dimensions and named map footprints.
